adapter.description: Deprecated and ignored (SPEC §12.1): the plane makes worktrees and runs the product's env hooks itself.

durable_docs_path.description: Durable DAG under product docs/, e.g. docs/delivery/

product_root.description: Absolute product main checkout (durable docs resolver)

watchdog.description: Historical Delivery Watchdog seat. Not used by the Claude team (SPEC §18.2).
Historical Delivery Watchdog cron. Not used by the Claude team (SPEC §18.2).

runner.description: Optional Task Runner cron; omit to keep existing routine

verifier.description: Task Verifier has NO routine: woken by the Runner, or on verify_stale by the Watchdog, or by the lead

verify_stale_minutes.description: The lead wakes the Verifier when a submitted/verifying task has no verdict and no verifier progress for >= this

ci.description: §15.1: the product runs the formal unit/lint workflow as CI; only then may a verdict cite gate.ci_run. Omit for no CI; CI is never the gate.

includes_gcloud_adc.description: A product that depends on cloud credentials sets true (§30). Products with no gcloud dependency may set false

auth_check.description: Deprecated (SPEC §30): auth probes are plane.json auth_check.probes. `script` names the product's own copy in the queue, which script-drift checks leave alone.

spec_maintainer.description: §17, deprecated and optional. The team lead always answers spec questions; the block is read only for `protocol_doc` (default: the plugin's spec-maintainer skill). The headless `claude-session` maintainer was removed on 2026-11-05. No secrets.

alias.description: Human-friendly name of the design seat

architecture_review.description: §19 Architecture review. Optional; missing block or enabled:false = no scheduled reviews. No secrets.

every_n_tasks.description: Due once this many durable tasks have reached done since the last review

max_days.description: Also due after this many days, if at least one task reached done since the last review

call_timeout_minutes.description: Wall-clock limit on the reviewer call

max_new_tasks.description: Cap on new tasks one triage may create

probes.description: Read-only command prefixes the reviewer may run, besides git/ls/wc (each becomes Bash(<probe>:*)). Nothing that writes, spends, sends or calls an agent

hosting.description: Deprecated and ignored: the plane has one hosting, the Claude team (SPEC §2.2). A leftover line of any value is read as if absent.

agent_type.description: Claude Code agent definition the lead spawns the runner from (.claude/agents/<agent_type>.md, managed copy)

name.description: Teammate name; the TeammateIdle hook (§18.2) acts only on this name

worktree.description: Absolute runner worktree on the integration branch (detached), for merges, reconciles and operator steps (§12.1)

rotate_after_tasks.description: Tasks one runner teammate completes before the lead rotates it (§10.2)

idle_block_limit.description: Consecutive TeammateIdle blocks on the same ready set before the hook lets the runner go idle (§18.2)

grok.description: Deprecated and ignored: Grok hosting was removed on 2026-11-05. A leftover block is read as if absent.
